ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)
protocol_type: Half-duplex addressed-bus request/(optional)reply messaging protocol. A control device transmits a 16-bit Manchester-encoded forward frame onto a 2-wire DC bus. The addressed control gear executes the encoded command. For query commands only, the addressed gear responds with an 8-bit backward frame 7×TE..22×TE after the forward frame. No NACK and no per-frame ACK — unsupported / malformed forward frames are silently discarded.

special_commands.name: WITHDRAW
special_commands.description: Gear with Random == Search drops out.

special_commands.name: VERIFY SHORT ADDRESS
special_commands.description: Gear with matching short addr answers 0xFF.

special_commands.name: QUERY SHORT ADDRESS
special_commands.description: Gear with Random == Search answers its short addr.

special_commands.name: PHYSICAL SELECTION
special_commands.description: Identify the gear that has been physically marked.

special_commands.name: ENABLE DEVICE TYPE X
special_commands.description: Enable DT-X command set for next frame.

special_commands.name: WRITE MEMORY LOCATION
special_commands.description: memory[(DTR1<<8)|DTR][DTR2] := data. Not supported in SLAA422A.

function_code_ranges.indirect_command_range: 0x00..0xFF when address byte's B bit = 1 (Y=0 short, Y=1 group/broadcast).
function_code_ranges.direct_arc_power_range: 0x00..0xFE = level 0..254 (0xFF = MASK) when address byte's B bit = 0.
function_code_ranges.special_command_address_range: Address byte 0xA0..0xCF with bit B=1 selects a Special Command (TERMINATE..WRITE MEMORY LOCATION).
function_code_ranges.broadcast_address_byte: 0xFE (Y=1 + AAAAAA=111111 + B=0) for direct level / 0xFF (Y=1 + AAAAAA=111111 + B=1) for indirect command.
function_code_ranges.group_address_range: 0..15 (encoded YAAAAAAB with Y=1 and AAAAAA low-2 = 00).

exception_codes.name: No NACK in DALI
exception_codes.meaning: Unsupported / malformed / out-of-window frames are silently discarded.

exception_codes.name: Backward-frame collision
exception_codes.meaning: Two simultaneous backward frames corrupt the bus.

exception_codes.name: Query timeout
exception_codes.meaning: No backward frame in 22×TE → no-response to control device.

channels.name: DALI 2-wire bus (DA+/DA-)
channels.framing: Manchester at 1200 baud; start + 8/16 data + 2 stop
channels.error_check: None at protocol layer — silent-discard on Manchester violation

host_bus_interface: Implementation-specific. SLAA422A uses MSP430 GPIO interrupt-on-edge + WDT+ interval timing + Timer_A3 PWM. No standardized CPU bus is mandated by IEC 62386.
valid_ready_handshake_rules: DALI is strictly forward-frame-then-optional-backward-frame; no per-byte ACK.
Backward frame only as response to query.
No backward frame from un-addressed gear or for non-query.
Control device shall wait ≥ 22×TE (9.17 ms) before next forward frame; 13.5 ms recommended.
Configuration Mode addressing-iteration uses RANDOMIZE/COMPARE/WITHDRAW/SEARCH/PROGRAM/VERIFY/QUERY SHORT ADDRESS.
Two-strike commit (100 ms window) required for destructive commands.

frame_format_forward.data_byte: 8 bits, MSB first; meaning depends on B bit of address byte (direct level vs indirect command).
frame_format_forward.total_bits_on_wire: 16 information bits + 1 start + 2 stop ≈ 19 bit-times Manchester.

frame_format_backward.data_byte: 8 bits, MSB first; encoding depends on the originating query.
frame_format_backward.total_bits_on_wire: 8 information bits + 1 start + 2 stop ≈ 11 bit-times Manchester.
frame_format_backward.timing: Starts between 7×TE and 22×TE after the end of the corresponding forward frame.
